title: Apple unveils its first foldable - the iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro official, Week 37 in review
description: Of course, Apple dominated the most popular stories of week 37 this year. Apple held a historic event on September 9 - the first in new CEO Ternus' reign, and the one to finally unveil the first foldable iPhone. Interestingly, the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max scored more hits than the iPhone Duo. Apple's latest Pro models got a variable aperture main lens, a faster A20 Pro SoC, and a smaller Dynamic Island. The iPhone 18 Pro series is now on sale, starting from $1,200/€1,450 and $1,300/€1,600, respectively, and will begin shipping on September 18. The iPhone Duo is, undoubtedly, the...

title: TCL P80 Ultra unboxing and hands-on
description: If you've clicked on this article, then you either know all about the TCL P80 Ultra, or at the very least, are interested in its NxtPaper AMOLED display. description: Apple’s brand new iPhone 18 Pro series is now available for pre-order, with sales set to begin on September 18. description: From the comments under last week’s poll we know that some of you have already bought a Poco F9 Ultra. description: Now that we've had a few days to mull over Apple's newest iPhones, it's time to share our initial thoughts. And since this is Apple we are talking about, there are no pre-order goodies – the opposite, actually, since Apple raised the iPhone 16, 17 and Air prices by $100. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE's India price leaks
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, unveiled last month, went on sale in select markets on September 4. India wasn't part of the first wave of rollout, as sales are scheduled to begin there on September 18. That may be why Samsung didn't reveal the Galaxy S26 FE's India price. However, if a new leak is to be believed, the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE will have a base price of INR69,999 in India. For that price, you'll get the Galaxy S26 FE's base model with 8GB RAM and 128GB storage. The 8GB/256GB model will cost INR79,999. title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max go on pre-order
description: The Apple iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, unveiled a few days ago, are now available for pre-orders through Apple's official website in 65 countries, including the US, the UK, Germany, Australia, Canada, China, France, India, and South Korea. Shipments and open sales in these 65 countries will begin on September 18, with the iPhone 18 Pro series going on sale in 20 more countries starting September 25. description: Realme teased the Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition a few days ago and confirmed India will be one of the launch markets. Realme has set up a promo page for the Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition on its official Indian website, confirming the smartphone will come with the Dimensity 7300 Max SoC, a 144Hz AMOLED display with 6,500 nits peak brightness, and a 7,000 mAh battery with 80W wired charging support. title: OnePlus 16 may not launch in India
description: According to a new rumor from a tipster on X, OnePlus may not be launching the upcoming OnePlus 16 in India. Instead, the OnePlus 16R will be the brand's next flagship in the country. It will be followed by new Nord series and N series devices. In recent years, OnePlus has launched a new flagship number-series device as well as an R-series model, which uses a lesser chipset and comes with lesser cameras and a big battery. description: Fairphone launched its first pair of true wireless earbuds, aptly called the Fairbuds, in April of 2024. title: Samsung Galaxy A08 retailer listing gives us specs and official images
description: The Samsung Galaxy A08 was spotted in the Google Play Console in August, and then got certified by Anatel in Brazil a few days later. Things have been quiet since then, but now the phone has shown up at an online retailer in the UAE, where it's seemingly already available for purchase for AED 625 ($170), down from the recommended price of AED 659 ($179). The phone sports a 6.7-inch PLS LCD screen with a 90Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera, a 2MP depth sensor, an 8MP front camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 25W fast charging. description: After leaking more than a communal tap, the iPhone Duo — Apple’s first foldable — is finally a reality. We are used to foldables around here, but for Apple, this is the first and only major new iPhone form factor in 19 years since the original iPhone. Needless to say, that’s a pretty big deal. title: Here's how much using one phone number on two iPhones will cost you
description: In iOS 27, which is being released to everyone on Monday, Apple is introducing a new feature that will let you use one phone number on two iPhones. It's called iPhone Handoff, and during its iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Duo launch event this week, Apple announced that it will be initially available on T-Mobile in the US and Telekom in Germany. Today, T-Mobile has revealed how much this feature will cost you, and it's going to be $5 per month. title: Apple extends free satellite features for older iPhones
description: A footnote in the iPhone 18 Pro press release revealed that Apple is providing an additional year of free satellite features for older iPhones. This means users with compatible iPhone models dating back to 2022’s iPhone 14 series will be able to enjoy Emergency SOS via satellite, Messages via satellite, Find My via satellite, and Roadside Assistance via satellite free of charge for at least one more year.
